expectations.buyer: Analytical laboratory managers, procurement teams, and method-development scientists
expectations.pain: Consumable substitutions can fail on geometry, material, solvent, instrument, and validated-method compatibility while OEM parts are costly or unavailable
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM compatibility tables, distributor catalogues, method libraries, laboratory experts, and chromatography supplier selectors
expectations.biggestRisk: Manufacturers and distributors may already publish sufficient cross-reference data, while liability and method revalidation make a neutral compatibility claim unsafe
